declarations.description:
Keeps its content pinned to the top or bottom edge of the nearest scroll container while the rest scrolls past, and
tells you when it is stuck: the host matches `:state(stuck)` and fires `stuck-change`, so the surface can gain a
background and shadow only once content runs beneath it. With `hide-on-scroll` it slides out of view while the reader
scrolls down and comes back on the way up or when focus moves into it (`:state(retracted)`).

Stickiness is CSS `position: sticky` on the host, so the usual rules apply: the host sticks within its parent, and
an ancestor with `overflow` set becomes the scroll container it sticks to. Turn it off with
`--c2-sticky--position: static`, which also switches the stuck state off.
declarations.name: Sticky

cssProperties.description: `sticky` pins the element; `static` turns pinning off, e.g. under a breakpoint.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky--position

cssProperties.description: Distance kept from the edge, e.g. the height of a sticky header above.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky--offset

cssProperties.description: Background while stuck, so scrolled content does not show through.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky__stuck--background

cssProperties.description: Shadow while stuck, separating the surface from the content beneath it.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky__stuck--box-shadow

cssProperties.description: Backdrop filter while stuck, e.g. `blur(12px)` with a translucent stuck background.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky__stuck--backdrop-filter

cssProperties.description: Duration of the stuck and retract transitions.
cssProperties.name: --c2-sticky--transition-duration

cssParts.description: Box wrapping the assigned default slot: it draws the padding, background and shadow around the slotted content, does not style inside it, and slides out of view while retracted.
cssParts.name: surface

slots.description: Content to keep in view: a toolbar, tabs, a table header, a section heading.

members.name: edge
members.description: The edge of the scroll container the content sticks to.

members.name: hideOnScroll
members.description: Slides the stuck content out of view while the reader scrolls down, and back in on the way up.

members.name: sticky
members.default: new StickyController(this, { internals: this.internals, edge: () => this.edge, hideOnScroll: () => this.hideOnScroll, })

members.name: stuck
members.description: Whether the content is currently pinned to its edge with content scrolling beneath it.

members.name: retracted
members.description: Whether `hide-on-scroll` has currently slid the content out of view.

members.name: reveal
members.description: Brings retracted content back into view.

events.description: Fired when the element becomes stuck to its edge or leaves it.
events.name: stuck-change

events.description: Fired when `hide-on-scroll` slides the element out of view or back in.
events.name: retract-change

attributes.name: edge
attributes.description: The edge of the scroll container the content sticks to.
